rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the stone marker at the head of a grave.

example.english: At Ching Ming, our whole family visits the graves and cleans the gravestone.
example.traditional: 清明節我哋一家人去拜山，順便抹乾淨祖先塊墓碑。
